registered: 2026-10-14, before any APA replay was run
question: Does TTI v5.16's Advanced Price Action (APA) detector fire often enough to scalp, why does it fire rarely, and does a triggered APA plan pay after costs on forex, Volatility and Jump?
code: TTI v5.16.0's own APA source (APA_CONFIG, swings, displacement, findFVG, analyseAPA, buildPlan, Wilder atr, TTI_FOUNDATION_REFERENCE), extracted verbatim from the HTML by apa_replay.mjs. referenceEntryRouteStudy is stubbed out: it is research output that never feeds the decision.
scan: at every closed bar, analyseAPA on the last 300 closed bars (no HTF bias, no RSI context, regime UNKNOWN as the browser falls back to). A setup is identified by its setupId; each setupId's furthest stage and last reason are counted (the funnel).
entry: a setup whose stage is TRIGGERED with triggerAt equal to the bar just closed, whose buildPlan is executionEligible (TP1 at least 1R), traded once per setupId: market entry at the next bar's open, paying the spread
exit: plan.stop or plan.tp1, stop first when one bar touches both; a gap through either fills at the bar's open; closed at the close after 96 bars otherwise
R: (exit - entry) x direction / |entry - stop|, minus spread / |entry - stop|; a trade whose next open is already beyond the stop or TP1 is not taken (counted)
control: the same bars, the opposite direction with the same stop and target distances (mirror)

variants.HTF: only when the higher timeframe agrees: last two confirmed k=5 swing highs and lows on H1 (for M5) or M15 (for M1) closed bars are HH/HL for a buy, LH/LL for a sell

markets.forex: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, XAUUSD, HistData M1 2024-10 to 2026-09; spread 0.0001 / 0.00015 / 0.012 / 0.35
markets.volatility: Deriv feed M1, about 90 days: R_10, R_25, R_50, R_75, R_100, 1HZ15V, 1HZ25V, 1HZ30V, 1HZ50V, 1HZ75V, 1HZ90V, 1HZ100V, 1HZ150V; spread = max(Deriv min spread, target spread % x price)
markets.jump: Deriv feed M1, about 90 days: J10, J25, J75, J100 (J50 has no published spread); spread as for volatility

spread_note: The 2026-10-14 demo journal showed Drift Switch spreads of about 4.0 against a published min of 0.2-0.4 and a target of about 2.5, so the published figures may be optimistic; results are also shown at 2x the spread.
halves: forex: 2024-10..2025-09 and 2025-10..2026-09; Deriv: the first and second half of each file by time
pass: per group (forex, volatility, jump) x timeframe x variant: net mean R > 0 with t >= 2 in BOTH halves, and the trade minus its mirror > 0 in both halves. Twelve cells; anything else is a fail.

amendment_1.registered: 2026-10-14, after the funnel counts of one smoke run (R_75 M5: 308 setups TRIGGERED, 264 of 297 fresh triggers blocked by TP1 < 1R) and before any trade outcome was computed
amendment_1.why: buildPlan's TP1 is the nearest confirmed swing including k=2 internal pivots, which is usually inside 1R; the 1R geometry floor then blocks almost every trigger. This is the main reason APA rarely fires.
amendment_1.variant_FIX15: every fresh trigger with a plan, ignoring the TP1 floor: stop = plan.stop, target = 1.5R from the actual entry. Same entry, exit, cost, control and pass rules as the registered rule.
amendment_1.pass: the same rule as the registered cells, applied to FIX15 as additional cells (ALL and HTF)
